title: Power Apps: GitHub-connected models and wider Maker Studio availability for generative pages
summary: Hold: the roadmap confirms consumption of the maker's GitHub credits, but does not establish where charges appear or where spending limits can be set. The dates and documented canvas-authoring control are accurate; the claims of a first-ever route and model changes without administrator action also exceed the evidence.
